pages.rm: Animal Cruelty Complaint in Assam – Animal Writes
pages.desc: Report animal cruelty in Assam: why e-FIR is not the route, how the police e-Complaint works, the State Board contact, cattle law and MVUs.
pages.focus: animal cruelty complaint assam,report animal cruelty assam,assam animal welfare board
pages.content:
In Assam, report animal cruelty through Assam Police's general online "e-Complaint", not its e-FIR, which takes only crimes against women, POCSO cases and vehicle theft (Assam Police, updated 16 Oct 2026). Assam also bars moving cattle from anywhere in the state to a district that borders a foreign country (Assam Cattle Preservation (Amendment) Act, 2021).

Report it to the police in Assam

  • Assam Police e-FIR is only for crimes against women, POCSO cases and vehicle theft. It is filed through Seva Setu (polcitizen.assam.gov.in), and the police station verifies it before converting it to an FIR (Assam Police, updated 16 Oct 2026).
  • For animal cruelty, use the general "e-Complaint". Assam Police converts an e-Complaint to an FIR if it is acceptable. A non-cognizable complaint is handled under the CrPC (Assam Police e-Complaint page, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • For emergencies, call 112.
  • For the laws (PCA Act s.11, BNS s.325), what to write, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see our national guide, How to file a police complaint (FIR) for animal cruelty.

Assam Animal Welfare Board / animal husbandry department

  • Member Secretary / Director AH & Veterinary, Chenikuthi, Guwahati 781003. Phone 0361-2668609 (Assam Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Department, contact page, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • The State Animal Welfare Board was reconstituted on 9 Jun 2020 under the PCA Act. The Animal Husbandry Minister is chair, the Director of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary is member secretary, and the Director General of Police Assam is a member (Assam Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Department, reconstitution notification, 9 Jun 2020).

Assam laws on animals

  • Assam Cattle Preservation Act, 2021 (Act XXV of 2021): Assam's cattle protection law (Assam Legislative Assembly, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • Assam Cattle Preservation (Amendment) Act, 2021 (Assam Gazette, 28 Jan 2022): bars transporting cattle from anywhere in Assam to a district that borders a foreign country (section 7(3)) (Assam Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Department, 28 Jan 2022).

faq: How do I report animal cruelty in Assam?
You can report animal cruelty in Assam through the Assam Police "e-Complaint". The police convert it to an FIR if it is acceptable. In an emergency, call 112.
Can I file an e-FIR for animal cruelty in Assam?
No, the Assam Police e-FIR is only for crimes against women, POCSO cases and vehicle theft. For animal cruelty, use the general e-Complaint instead.
What is the contact of the Assam State Animal Welfare Board?

The Assam State Animal Welfare Board's contact is the Member Secretary / Director AH & Veterinary, Chenikuthi, Guwahati 781003. The phone number is 0361-2668609. The Board was reconstituted on 9 Jun 2020, with the Animal Husbandry Minister as chair.
Which law protects cattle in Assam?

The Assam Cattle Preservation Act, 2021 (Act XXV of 2021) is the cattle protection law in Assam. Its 2021 amendment bars transporting cattle from anywhere in Assam to a district that borders a foreign country (section 7(3)).

pages.desc: Report animal cruelty in Bihar: the e-complaint on the CCTNS Citizen Service Portal, the State Animal Welfare Board in Patna and Bihar's cattle law.
pages.focus: animal cruelty complaint bihar,report animal cruelty bihar,bihar animal welfare board
pages.content:
In Bihar you can file an online complaint ("ई-शिकायत") on the police's Citizen Service Portal, and AWBI forwards cruelty complaints from Bihar to the State Animal Welfare Board in Patna (Bihar CCTNS Citizen Service Portal; AWBI cruelty complaint register 2024-25). Bihar's 1955 animals law bans the slaughter of cows, calves, bulls, bullocks and she-buffaloes.

Report it to the police in Bihar

  • Bihar's CCTNS Citizen Service Portal offers an e-complaint ("ई-शिकायत"). It also handles lost property, missing persons, verifications and FIR copies. No e-FIR is listed on the portal, so use the e-complaint (Bihar CCTNS Citizen Service Portal, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • For emergencies, call 112.
  • For the laws (PCA Act s.11, BNS s.325), what to write, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see our national guide, How to file a police complaint (FIR) for animal cruelty.

Bihar Animal Welfare Board / animal husbandry department

  • Bihar's State Animal Welfare Board was constituted on 6 May 2022 (AWBI list of State Animal Welfare Boards, Sep 2022).
  • Member Secretary / Director, State Animal Husbandry Dept, Pragati Nagar, Sipara, Patna 800002 (AWBI cruelty complaint register 2024-25).
  • AWBI forwards cruelty complaints for Bihar to the Board's Member Secretary at this address (AWBI cruelty complaint register 2024-25).

Bihar laws on animals

  • Bihar Preservation and Improvement of Animals Act, 1955 (Act II of 1956): Bihar's main cattle law (Bihar Animal and Fisheries Resources Department, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • Section 3: no slaughter of a cow, calf, bull, bullock or she-buffalo (same source).
  • Section 4: the penalty is up to 6 months' imprisonment, a fine of up to Rs 1,000, or both (same source).
  • Section 4A: no export of cattle from Bihar (same source).
  • Section 4B: police officers of the rank of ASI and above may arrest without a warrant (same source).

You can report animal cruelty in Bihar with an e-complaint ("ई-शिकायत") on the CCTNS Citizen Service Portal. In an emergency, call 112. Our national guide explains what to write and what to do if the police refuse.
Can I file an e-FIR for animal cruelty in Bihar?
Bihar's CCTNS Citizen Service Portal lists no e-FIR, so use its e-complaint ("ई-शिकायत") for animal cruelty.
What is the contact of the Bihar State Animal Welfare Board?

The Bihar State Animal Welfare Board's contact is the Member Secretary / Director, State Animal Husbandry Dept, Pragati Nagar, Sipara, Patna 800002. AWBI forwards cruelty complaints for Bihar to this address.
Which law protects cattle in Bihar?

The Bihar Preservation and Improvement of Animals Act, 1955 protects cattle in Bihar. It bars the slaughter of cows, calves, bulls, bullocks and she-buffaloes, and the export of cattle from Bihar. Police officers of ASI rank and above may arrest without a warrant.

Every district in Jharkhand has a District SPCA, with the Deputy Commissioner as president and the Superintendent of Police as vice president (Jharkhand Animal Husbandry Department, checked 25 Oct 2026). For a police complaint, the state lists an online FIR and complaint system.

Report it to the police in Jharkhand

  • The state lists the "Jharkhand Online FIR/Complaint Management System" at jofs.jhpolice.gov.in (Government of Jharkhand portal, checked 25 Oct 2026). We could not confirm which complaints it accepts. If it does not take yours, give a written complaint at the police station.

  • For the laws (PCA Act s.11, BNS s.325), what to write, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see our national guide, How to file a police complaint (FIR) for animal cruelty.

Jharkhand State Animal Welfare Board

Other help in Jharkhand

The Deputy Commissioner is its president, the Superintendent of Police is vice president and the District Animal Husbandry Officer is member secretary. Its duties include the transport rules (Jharkhand Animal Husbandry Department, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • Jharkhand Gau Sewa Ayog: set up under Act 02 of 2006, it deals with custody of seized cattle. It is at Doranda, Ranchi (Jharkhand Animal Husbandry Department, checked 25 Oct 2026).

pages.rm: Animal Cruelty Complaint in Kerala – Animal Writes
pages.desc: Report animal cruelty in Kerala: police complaints through THUNA or Pol-App, the State Animal Welfare Board contact, the 1962 call centre and a new Bill.
pages.focus: animal cruelty complaint kerala,report animal cruelty kerala,kerala animal welfare board
pages.content:
In Kerala you can send an animal cruelty complaint to the police online, through the THUNA portal or the Pol-App, without visiting a police station (Kerala Police circular 13/2022/PHQ, 27 Apr 2022). Any police office will take it and forward it to the right station.

Report it to the police in Kerala

  • You can send any complaint or petition to Kerala Police through the THUNA portal or the Pol-App. You do not need to visit a police station (Kerala Police circular 13/2022/PHQ, 27 Apr 2022).
  • Any police office will register a complaint that belongs to another station. It is forwarded to that station automatically (Kerala Police circular 13/2022/PHQ, 27 Apr 2022).
  • For emergencies, call 112.
  • For the laws (PCA Act s.11, BNS s.325), what to write, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see our national guide, How to file a police complaint (FIR) for animal cruelty.

Kerala State Animal Welfare Board

  • Kerala's State Animal Welfare Board was constituted on 11 Aug 2021 (AWBI list of State Animal Welfare Boards, Sep 2022).
  • AWBI lists the Board's contact as the Director of Animal Husbandry, Vikas Bhavan, Thiruvananthapuram (AWBI list of State Animal Welfare Boards, Sep 2022).

Kerala laws on animals

  • Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Kerala Amendment) Bill, 2025: passed by the Kerala Legislative Assembly on 9 Oct 2025 (Kerala Legislative Assembly, Bill as passed, 9 Oct 2025). It deals with cattle races held with the Collector's permission. We could not find that it has received assent (checked 25 Oct 2026).

1962 and mobile veterinary units in Kerala

  • Kerala has 29 Mobile Veterinary Units across 29 blocks, and 47 more are planned (Kerala Animal Husbandry Department, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • A 1962 call centre runs 24x7 (Kerala Animal Husbandry Department, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • PIB reported the inauguration of the 29 units and the 1962 call centre (PIB, 5 Jan 2023).
  • 1962 is the toll-free number for doorstep veterinary service from MVUs (PIB, 26 Mar 2025).

What is the contact of the Kerala State Animal Welfare Board?
The Kerala State Animal Welfare Board is listed by AWBI under the Director of Animal Husbandry, Vikas Bhavan, Thiruvananthapuram. The Board was constituted on 11 Aug 2021.

The PCA (Kerala Amendment) Bill, 2025 deals with cattle races held with the Collector's permission. It was passed by the Kerala Legislative Assembly on 9 Oct 2025. We could not find that it has received assent.

Mizoram has its own laws on animals, including the Mizoram Animal Slaughter Act, 2013 and the Mizoram Regulation of Animal Movement Act, 2000. The state's Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Department administers them along with the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act (Citizens' Charter 2025-26).

Report it to the police in Mizoram

  • The Mizoram Police website links to the CCTNS citizen portal. Its helpline page lists 112, 1930, 181 and 1098 (Mizoram Police, helpline numbers page, 6 Aug 2025).

pages.desc: Report animal cruelty in Tamil Nadu with the State Animal Welfare Board's online complaint form. Board contact, state amendment Act and rules inside.
pages.focus: animal cruelty complaint tamil nadu,report animal cruelty tamil nadu,tamil nadu animal welfare board
pages.content:
In Tamil Nadu you can report animal cruelty online to the Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board, on its own complaint form. It covers cruelty, illegal trade, neglect, illegal slaughter, stray issues and Jallikattu, and you can upload photos or videos and track your complaint (Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board, checked 25 Oct 2026). Before going to the police, note the Madras High Court's 2026 ruling below.

Complain to the Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board

  • The Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board has its own online complaint form. It covers cruelty, illegal trade, neglect, illegal slaughter, stray issues and Jallikattu. You can upload files and track your complaint (Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board complaint form and tracking page, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • You can also write to the Board: 13/1 3rd Seaward Road, Valmiki Nagar, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai 600041; 044-24575701; tnawb23@gmail.com (Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board website, checked 25 Oct 2026).

A Madras High Court ruling (2026) on police complaints

  • On 1 Sep 2026 the Madras High Court held that cruelty under section 11(1)(a) of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act (beating, kicking, overloading, torturing or otherwise causing unnecessary pain) is a non-cognizable offence. For a first offence the punishment is a fine of Rs 10 to Rs 50 (Balaji v. State, Crl.O.P. No. 9632 of 2026, paras 3 to 5).
  • So the police must get the magistrate's permission, under section 174(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, before registering an FIR for that offence. The court quashed a case where they had not (same judgment, paras 5 and 6).
  • Killing, poisoning or maiming an animal is a separate offence under section 325 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, which is cognizable.
  • Read the judgment in our Library.

Report it to the police in Tamil Nadu

  • We could not verify a Tamil Nadu-specific online police complaint service.
  • In an emergency, call 112.
  • For the laws, what to write in your complaint, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see How to file a police complaint (FIR) for animal cruelty.

Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board

  • Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board, 13/1 3rd Seaward Road, Valmiki Nagar, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai 600041. Phone 044-24575701. Email tnawb23@gmail.com (Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board website, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • The Board's Chairman is the Chief Minister (Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board website, checked 25 Oct 2026).

Tamil Nadu laws on animals

  • PCA (TN Amendment) Act No. 1 of 2017: a Tamil Nadu amendment to the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act (Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board, Acts page, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • G.O.Ms.No.19 of 22 Jan 2026: a government order on joy-ride horses (Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board, Acts page, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • The Board also publishes policies on dog breeding and pet boarding (Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board, Acts page, checked 25 Oct 2026).
